```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

theme_aoas <- function(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = rel(1.2),
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(t = 0, b = 8) 
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = rel(0.95),
        color = "grey30"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey85",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
    )
}
```


# Rolling window

```{r}
library(forcats)
my_windows <- generate_rolling_windows(SEED = 1)  

df_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(my_windows, ~ mutate(.x, window = .y))
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = c("train", "calibration", "test")),
    window = factor(window, levels = sort(unique(window)))
  )
```

```{r}
date_min <- min(df_all$Date)
date_max <- max(df_all$Date)

major_breaks <- seq(date_min, date_max, by = "6 months")
minor_breaks <- seq(date_min, date_max, by = "14 days")
```

```{r}
g <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = Date, y = fct_rev(window), fill = type)) +
  
  geom_tile(
    height = 0.85,
    linewidth = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      calibration = "#A3BEDB",
      train = "#6F93BD",
      test = "#4A6FA5"
    ),
    labels = c(
      train = "Train",
      calibration = "Calib",
      test = "Test"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = major_breaks,        # visible (6 months)
    minor_breaks = minor_breaks,  # structure (14 days)
    date_labels = "%Y-%m",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_aoas(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
  
  theme(
    # ❌ no visible vertical grid
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    
    # ❌ no horizontal grid either (clean AOAS)
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    
    # ✔️ x ticks only (6 months + implicit structure)
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(2.5, "pt"),
    
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    
    plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10)
  )
```


```{r}
ggsave("../Figures/windows.pdf", g, width = 10, height = 2)
```



# National data

```{r}
national_data_path <- "../Data/dataset_scotland_main.csv"

# Dataset
dataset_scotland <- read.csv(national_data_path) %>% 
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% preparation_data_scotland()
print(min(dataset_scotland$Date))
print(max(dataset_scotland$Date))

```

```{r}

g <- ggplot(dataset_scotland, aes(x = Date, y = Consumed_kWh)) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scotland",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Consumed kWh"
  ) +
  theme_aoas()
ggsave("../Figures/Scotland_series.pdf", g, width = 5, height = 3)

```

# Glasgow

```{r}
regional_data_path <- "../Data/dataset_region_main.csv"

# Dataset
dataset_glasgow<- read.csv(regional_data_path) %>% 
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% preparation_data_regions_stations(group_col=Region) %>%
  filter(Region == "Glasgow City")
```

```{r}

g <- ggplot(dataset_glasgow, aes(x = Date, y = Consumed_kWh)) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Glasgow",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Consumed kWh"
  ) +
  theme_aoas()
g
ggsave("../Figures/Glasgow_series.pdf", g, , width = 5, height = 2)

```

# Stations

```{r}
station_data_path <- "../Data/dataset_address_main.csv"

# Dataset
dataset_stations <- data.table::fread(station_data_path) %>% 
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% preparation_data_regions_stations(group_col=Station.ID)
```

```{r}
stations_glasgow <- dataset_stations %>%
  filter(Region == "Glasgow City") 
stations_glasgow <- as.character(unique(stations_glasgow$Station.ID))
length(stations_glasgow)
```

```{r}
stations_stirling <- dataset_stations %>%
  filter(Region == "Stirling") %>%
  filter(Address == "Dunblane")
stations_dunblane <- as.character(unique(stations_stirling$Station.ID))
length(stations_dunblane)
```
